column1: # 16 MB flash. Two OTA app slots (future firmware updates from the companion app / Wi-Fi)
# 0.7.3: ota_1 shrinks by 64 KB (never used: the installers always boot ota_0) to make room for a core dump partition that
# keeps the evidence of a crash across the reset. Every other partition keeps its offset and size (docs/PARTITIONS_0.7.3.md).
